issue_context.title: Efergy sensors not showing up in new Energy Consumption sensor list
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Efergy sensors not showing up in new Energy Consumption sensor list. After investigation they are found to be missing the state_class, device_class and last_reset atributes on the energy consumption (amount/period) entities. As a temporary workaround, adding these manually in entity customisation makes the sensor accessible, however requires manually updating the last_reset attribute. Maintenance can be reduced by setting up an Efergy yearly consumption sensor, meaning the last_reset attribute needs to be manually updated only once a year.

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor/#long-term-statistics

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Efergy

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/efergy/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
